picks.title: Variational wavefunctions for ideal anyon gas: superfluid and skyrmion Hall crystal
picks.subjects: Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)
picks.why_zh: 把复合玻色子/费米子与 parton 波函数接到球面上的神经网络关联，覆盖任意子超流与 skyrmion Hall 晶体——NNQS × 任意子统计 × FCI 相关多体。
picks.summary_zh: 理想任意子气体的基态长期未决，并因分数量子霍尔/分数量子陈绝缘体实验再度升温。作者构造内建精确交换统计的变分波函数，并把理论引导的复合玻色子、复合费米子与 parton 态与球面上的神经网络关联结合。对无自旋与 SU(2) semion，确认配对任意子超流能量显著低于最佳晶体；θ=π/3 时无自旋情形液/晶更接近。对带 SU(3) 味的 θ=π/3 任意子，找到两类候选：skyrmion Hall 晶体（任意子在自旋织构等效磁场中形成整数量子霍尔态），以及六任意子团簇的手性色超导（超行列式而非 parton 行列式之积）；在所给变分 ansatz 下色超导优于晶体与对照液体。工作把 NNQS 直接接到任意子超流与拓扑晶体竞争。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID。 未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: The ground state of an ideal gas of anyons with statistical angle $\theta\in(0,\pi)$ is a long-standing open problem, with renewed interest from the recent observations of fractional Chern insulators. In this work we construct variational wavefunctions that build in the exact anyon statistics and combine theory-guided composite-boson, composite-fermion and parton wavefunctions with neural-network correlations on the sphere. For spinless and SU(2) semions we confirm the paired anyon superfluid, well below the best crystal states. At $\theta=\pi/3$ liquids and crystals are closer in energy for the spinless case. For $\theta=\pi/3$ anyons with SU(3) flavor, we find two candidates. One is a skyrmion Hall crystal, in which the anyons form an integer quantum Hall state in the effective magnetic field from the spin texture. The other is a chiral color superconductor of six-anyon clusters, the color-flavor-locked pairing descendant of a holon metal with SU(3) color gauge symmetry and SU(3) flavor symmetry; its wavefunction is a hyperdeterminant rather than a product of parton determinants. Within our variational ansatz the color superconductor has better energy than both crystals and the color-flavor locked phases with U(1)$^2$ and Z$_3$ gauge groups. For twisted MoTe$_2$ this suggests that the reentrant integer quantum anomalous Hall phase is the skyrmion Hall crystal of the doped anyons, and that the observed superconductivity may be the color superconductor, which can undergo a transition to an $f+if$ BCS superconductor with a jump of the chiral central charge by 3.

picks.title: Observation of light-induced topological state in graphene
picks.authors: Sotirios Fragkos · Ann Chantal Goutier · Umberto Dellasette 等
picks.authors_full: Sotirios Fragkos , Ann Chantal Goutier , Umberto Dellasette , Dominique Descamps , Stéphane Petit , Wiebke Bennecke , Philip Hofmann , Marcel Reutzel , Stefan Mathias , Yann Mairesse , Michael Schüler , Samuel Beaulieu
picks.why_zh: 圆偏振驱动石墨烯中用圆二色 trARPES/动量显微观测到泵浦诱导的近 Dirac 点光电子圆二色，符号随泵浦手性与 Dirac 能翻转——Floquet Chern × 实验拓扑态。
picks.summary_zh: 圆偏振光驱动石墨烯被预言在 Dirac 点开隙并诱导 Haldane 型赝自旋织构与 Berry 曲率，实现 Floquet Chern 绝缘体；既往输运/全光测量给出光致反常霍尔证据，但难同时在能量–动量空间分辨电子态，而线偏振 trARPES 虽见 Floquet–Bloch 边带却保持时间反演、不诱导拓扑相。作者结合圆二色时间分辨极紫外动量显微与第一性原理，观测到泵浦诱导的近 Dirac 点光电子圆二色：符号随泵浦手性翻转，并跨 Dirac 能变号，与计算的 Floquet 拓扑态一致。结果为光致拓扑态提供动量分辨的直接光谱指纹。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID。 库内有 Light-induced anomalous Hall effect in graphene、Towards Floquet Chern insulators of light 等近邻条目。
picks.abstract: Driving quantum materials with light can reshape not only their electronic band structures but also the geometry of their electronic wavefunctions. In graphene, circularly polarized light is predicted to open gaps at the Dirac points and induce a pseudospin texture and Berry curvature characteristic of the Haldane model, realizing a Floquet Chern insulator. Transport and all-optical measurements have provided evidence for a light-induced anomalous Hall response, but cannot resolve the underlying electronic states in both energy and momentum space. Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy has revealed Floquet-Bloch sidebands and hybridization gaps at crossings between Floquet bands. However, these experiments used linearly polarized driving, which preserves time-reversal symmetry and thus does not induce a topological phase. Here, we combine circular-dichroic time-resolved extreme-ultraviolet momentum microscopy with ab initio theory to investigate graphene driven by circularly polarized light. We observe a pump-induced photoemission circular dichroism near the Dirac point that reverses sign with pump helicity and across the Dirac energy, in agreement with our calculations. These results link the measured dichroic response to the light-induced pseudospin texture and its associated Berry curvature, providing spectroscopic evidence for the Floquet-engineered topological insulating state in graphene.

picks.title: Nonreciprocal Floquet tunneling dynamics of spin-orbit-coupled bosonic atoms in a non-Hermitian double-well potential
picks.authors: Limei Ju · Yingying Zhang · Jilei Liang 等
picks.authors_full: Limei Ju , Yingying Zhang , Jilei Liang , Shoukang Chang , Zunlue Zhu , Lu Qin , Wuming Liu , Xingdong Zhao
picks.why_zh: 非厄米双阱中自旋–轨道耦合玻色原子的非互易 Floquet 隧穿：增益损耗与非互易耦合协同扩大稳定自旋翻转区——非厄米 × Floquet × SOC。
picks.summary_zh: 非厄米体系中稳定隧穿与非互易耦合如何调控自旋输运，是开放量子器件的基本问题。作者把自旋–轨道耦合玻色原子置于含增益损耗的双阱，解析 Floquet 态与准能谱得到 PT 对称相图，并考察非互易耦合强度、增益损耗非厄米强度与周期驱动对稳定自旋翻转隧穿的协同调控。结果表明精确操控非互易与增益损耗可显著扩大稳定参数区；在平衡增益损耗的非互易系统中，稳定区连续或离散由驱动频率比 Ω/ω₀ 的奇偶性决定。工作把非厄米、Floquet 与 SOC 自旋隧穿接到同一可控平台。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID。 未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: The stable tunneling dynamics in non-Hermitian quantum systems is one of the fundamental issues in the study of quantum transport. Nonreciprocal coupling, as another crucial manifestation of non-Hermiticity, exerts significant regulatory effects on the stability of quantum devices and on spin tunneling dynamics. Here we place spin-orbit-coupled bosonic atoms in a double-well potential with gain and loss, and investigate the effect of nonreciprocal coupling on the system dynamics. Through an analytical analysis of the Floquet states and the quasi-energy spectrum under periodic driving, we obtain the PT-symmetry phase diagram of the system. We further explore the synergistic regulation mechanism of several factors---including the strength of nonreciprocal coupling, the non-Hermitian strength arising from gain-loss, and the periodic driving---on stable spin-flip tunneling. The results show that precise manipulation of nonreciprocity and gain-loss can substantially enlarge the stable parameter region. In nonreciprocal systems with balanced gain and loss, the continuity or discreteness of the stable parameter region is determined by the parity of the driving-frequency ratio $\Omega/\omega$, and the spin-flip tunneling can be precisely controlled through the parameters $\lambda$ and $2\varepsilon/\omega$. For the unbalanced gain-loss scenario, the equilibrium conditions for achieving stable spin-flip tunneling under different parities of $\Omega/\omega$ are further provided. These findings offer a new theoretical approach for realizing robust spin-flip tunneling, provide guiding significance for the study of quantum-state transport in non-Hermitian ultracold atomic systems, and also serve as a reference for the experimental design of novel spin-based quantum devices.

picks.title: Non-Bloch Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions with Memory
picks.authors: Zhesen Yang · Wei-Wei Yang · Henning Schomerus · Jiangping Hu
picks.authors_full: Zhesen Yang , Wei-Wei Yang , Henning Schomerus , Jiangping Hu
picks.subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Optics (physics.optics); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)
picks.why_zh: 带记忆的衬底耦合使厄米链出现仅开放边界才有的非 Bloch DQPT，由投影传播子点隙绕数 W 决定——开放/记忆 × 非厄米拓扑 × DQPT。
picks.summary_zh: 周期链的动力学量子相变通常由实 Bloch 动量决定。作者识别仅开放链才出现、由复动量决定的非 Bloch DQPT：它们出现在耦合到简单衬底、记忆被精确处理的厄米链中，并源于投影传播子的点隙绕数 W——当 W≠0 时，即便热力学极限下开放边界也会改变动力学自由能与临界时刻。二者均可由向复动量的解析延拓得到，且 W 可用粒子计数测量。结果揭示动力学体–边对应：非厄米拓扑可从带记忆的厄米动力学中涌现。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID。 库内有 non-Bloch / DQPT 相关条目，主题相邻。
picks.abstract: Dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) of periodic chains are determined by real Bloch momenta. We identify non-Bloch DQPTs, which occur only in open chains and are determined by complex momenta instead. They arise in a Hermitian chain coupled to a simple substrate, whose memory is treated exactly, and originate from the point-gap winding number $W$ of the projected propagator: for $W\neq0$, open boundaries change both the dynamical free energy and the critical times, even in the thermodynamic limit. We find that both follow from an analytic continuation to complex momenta, and show that $W$ can be measured by particle counting. This reveals a dynamical bulk-boundary correspondence, in which non-Hermitian topology emerges from Hermitian dynamics with memory.

picks.title: Nodal magnon spin current at an antiferromagnet/altermagnet junction
picks.subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)
picks.why_zh: d 波交错磁与反铁磁结的热驱动磁子自旋流：子格对称界面下 AFM/AM 结对畴平均保留 d 波角依赖并作磁子阀——交错磁 × 自旋电子学。
picks.summary_zh: 作者研究 d 波交错磁（AM）与铁磁（FM）或反铁磁（AFM）结上热驱动的磁子自旋流：电流含与界面角无关分量及 d 波形角依赖分量。对子格对称界面，畴反转下两种结行为相反——FM/AM 的角依赖分量为奇并在畴平均后抵消；AFM/AM 的角无关分量由对称性消失，角依赖分量在固定 AFM Néel 矢量下可经畴平均存活。选择性隧穿使平行跨界面自旋对可传磁子、反平行则阻断，从而 AFM/AM 结成为磁子阀。各向异性隧穿可由 [310] 与 [130] 法向界面电流变号探测。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID。 库内交错磁主题条目较多，但本题为新机制/新结型。
picks.abstract: We investigate the thermally driven magnon spin current across a junction between a $d$-wave altermagnet (AM) and a ferromagnet (FM) or an antiferromagnet (AFM). The current consists of a component independent of the interface angle and an angularly dependent component with the $d$-wave form. For a sublattice-symmetric interface, the two junctions behave oppositely under reversal of the altermagnetic domain: in the FM/AM junction the angularly dependent component is odd and cancels on averaging over the domains, whereas in the AFM/AM junction the angularly independent component vanishes by symmetry and the angularly dependent component survives the domain average at a fixed Néel vector of the AFM. Both follow from a selective tunneling: a pair of spins bonded across the interface transmits magnons when the spins are parallel and not when antiparallel, which makes the AFM/AM junction a magnon valve: the configuration in which the bonded spins are antiparallel blocks the current up to the sublattice admixture of the magnons. The anisotropic tunneling is detectable as the sign reversal of the current between the interfaces normal to $[310]$ and $[130]$, and the valve reads the Néel vector of the altermagnet relative to that of the antiferromagnet through the magnitude of the current at a fixed interface.

picks.title: Meta-Altermagnetism and Enhanced Spin-Splitting
picks.why_zh: 自旋劈裂 van Hove 奇点跨费米面可触发一级“元交错磁”跃迁，中间相八极矩与自旋劈裂电导反常增强——交错磁 × 自旋劈裂增强。
picks.summary_zh: 交错磁是净磁化为零却有自旋劈裂能带的共线磁体。作者追问交错磁是否可发生不连续跃迁（元交错磁）：在二维中，磁有序诱导的能带重构把自旋劈裂 van Hove 奇点推过费米面即可触发。扩展 t–J 模型平均场显示，一级元交错磁跃迁给出中间交错磁区——交错磁化减弱，但磁八极矩与时间反演奇的自旋劈裂电导反而显著增强；一级线终止于量子临界端点，随化学势与各向异性跃迁强度给出丰富相图。自旋劈裂 vHS 被指认为增强自旋劈裂效应的通路。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID。 库内交错磁主题条目较多，但本题为新机制/新结型。
picks.abstract: Altermagnets are collinear magnets with zero net magnetization and spin-split electronic bands. Here, we explore whether altermagnetism can exhibit a discontinuous jump, a phenomenon we refer to as meta-altermagnetism. We show that meta-altermagnetism can emerge in 2D systems when magnetic-order-induced band reconstruction drives spin-split van Hove singularities (vHSs) across the Fermi level. Using mean-field theory for an extended $t$-$J$ model on a two-sublattice square lattice including anisotropic hopping integral, we find that a first-order meta-altermagnetic transition produces an intermediate altermagnetic regime with reduced staggered magnetization but strongly enhanced magnetic octupole and time-reversal-odd spin-splitter conductivity. We further show that the first-order transition line terminates at a quantum critical endpoint, giving rise to a rich phase diagram as the chemical potential and anisotropic hopping strength are varied. Our results identify the spin split vHSs as a route to enhancing spin-splitter effect for spintronic applications.

picks.title: Light-induced chiral altermagnets from conventional antiferromagnets
picks.authors: Jorge Cardenas-Gamboa · Devika Jayadeep · Aritz Leonardo 等
picks.authors_full: Jorge Cardenas-Gamboa , Devika Jayadeep , Aritz Leonardo , Gregory A. Fiete , Jeroen van den Brink , Maia G. Vergniory
picks.why_zh: 对称分析给出手性声子等畸变把常规反铁磁诱导为交错磁；Fe₂TeO₆ 中红外脉冲驱动瞬态手性结构并出现非相对论自旋劈裂——光控 × 交错磁。
picks.summary_zh: 交错磁兼具补偿共线磁序与动量依赖非相对论自旋劈裂。作者提出经相干晶格调控光学诱导交错磁的路径：对称分析识别在保持连接相反自旋子格的转动对称性的同时抬起常规反铁磁自旋简并的声子畸变；其中几何手性声子把交错磁出现与结构手性相连。以 Fe₂TeO₆ 为原型，线偏振中红外脉冲可经红外活性声子与光学静默对称破缺模之间的负双二次耦合驱动结构不稳；第一性原理晶格动力学给出瞬态手性畸变，电子结构确认光致结构具交错磁特征的非相对论自旋劈裂。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID。 库内交错磁主题条目较多，但本题为新机制/新结型。
picks.abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated collinear magnetic order with momentum-dependent nonrelativistic spin splitting, offering new opportunities for spintronic applications. Here, we propose a route to optically induce altermagnetism through coherent lattice control. Using symmetry analysis, we identify phonon distortions that lift the spin degeneracy of conventional antiferromagnets while preserving the rotational symmetries connecting opposite-spin sublattices. Among these, geometric chiral phonons provide a particularly appealing pathway, linking the emergence of altermagnetism to structural chirality. Taking Fe$_2$TeO$_6$ as a prototype, we demonstrate that a linearly polarized mid-infrared pulse can drive a structural instability through negative biquadratic coupling between an infrared-active phonon and an optically silent, symmetry-breaking mode. First-principles-based lattice dynamics reveal the emergence of a transient chiral distortion, while electronic-structure calculations establish that the light-induced structure exhibits nonrelativistic spin splitting characteristic of altermagnetism. Our results establish a symmetry-guided pathway toward the ultrafast optical control of altermagnetic states through nonlinear phononics.

picks.title: Exploring Fractional Quantum Hall States with Deep Learning: From Abelian to Non-Abelian Phases
picks.authors: Xiangyu Ma · Kehuang Chen · Yuntian Gu 等
picks.authors_full: Xiangyu Ma , Kehuang Chen , Yuntian Gu , Weiluo Ren , Ji Chen , Di Luo , Fengcheng Wu , Xiang Li
picks.subjects: Computational Physics (physics.comp-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el)
picks.why_zh: 对称适应的神经网络波函数同时描述 Abel/非 Abel FQHE 并纳入全部朗道能级，有限尺寸重叠与纠缠谱支持 parton/反 Pfaffian 证据——NNQS × FQHE 拓扑序。
picks.summary_zh: 分数量子霍尔体系竞争拓扑相近简并且朗道能级混合难处理。作者引入对称适应的神经网络波函数，可同时描述 Abel 与非 Abel 态并纳入全部朗道能级：方法准确捕捉复合费米液体及低填充下 Wigner 结晶的出现；第一朗道能级部分填充时，有限尺寸重叠与纠缠谱给出与 ν=4/3、7/5 处 parton 相相一致的证据，而 ν=3/2 呈现类反 Pfaffian 纠缠结构。神经网络波函数由此成为研究 FQHE 竞争拓扑序的灵活框架。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID。 未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: Fractional quantum Hall systems host strongly correlated topological phases with potential applications in topological quantum computation, yet identifying their microscopic ground states remains challenging because competing phases are often nearly degenerate and Landau-level mixing is difficult to treat. Here, we introduce a symmetry-adapted neural-network wavefunction that describes Abelian and non-Abelian states while incorporating all Landau levels. The method accurately captures composite-fermion liquids and the emergence of Wigner crystallization at low filling. When the first Landau level is partially filled, finite-size overlaps and entanglement spectra provide evidence consistent with $\bar{2}^{k}1^{k+1}$-type parton phases at $\nu=4/3$ and $7/5$, while the $\nu=3/2$ state exhibits anti-Pfaffian-like entanglement structure. These results demonstrate that neural-network wavefunctions offer a flexible framework for studying competing topological orders in fractional quantum Hall systems.

picks.title: Resonance and Transition-Channel Competition in Cavity-Assisted Floquet-State Stabilization
picks.authors: Zhuocheng Ma · Hongzheng Zhao · Liang-You Peng
picks.authors_full: Zhuocheng Ma , Hongzheng Zhao , Liang-You Peng
picks.why_zh: 耗散腔辅助 Floquet 本征态稳定在中等驱动频率下不只依赖共振，而由共振选择与腔诱导跃迁强度的竞争决定——开放系统 × Floquet 稳定化。
picks.summary_zh: 静态耦合到耗散腔曾被提出可自主稳定 Floquet 本征态：腔在光子能量匹配准能差（模驱动量子）时提供能量选择弛豫通道。作者表明在中等驱动频率下，仅共振条件并不足以保证稳定——稳态由共振选择与腔诱导 Floquet 态间跃迁强度的协作/竞争共同控制，可导致成功稳定、共振下仍混合的稳态，以及 Floquet 区杂化附近的完全失效。同一机制可推广到多能级自旋-S 系统，给出静态耗散何时可靠稳定驱动量子态的一般框架。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID。 未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: Static coupling to a dissipative cavity has been proposed as a route to autonomously stabilize Floquet eigenstates. The cavity provides an energy-selective relaxation channel: when its photon energy matches a quasienergy difference modulo drive quanta, it mediates transitions between Floquet states, followed by irreversible photon loss. Here, we show that at intermediate driving frequencies, this resonance condition alone is not sufficient for stabilization. Instead, the steady state is controlled by the interplay between resonance selection and the cavity-induced transition strengths between Floquet states, which can either cooperate or compete. This interplay leads to successful stabilization, mixed steady states despite resonance, and complete breakdown near Floquet-zone hybridization. We further show that the same mechanism extends to multilevel spin-S systems, providing a general framework for understanding when static dissipation can reliably stabilize driven quantum states.

picks.title: Generating Multipartite Entanglement via Structured-Bath Engineering
picks.authors: Baptiste Debecker · Philipp Westhoff · Visal So 等
picks.authors_full: Baptiste Debecker , Philipp Westhoff , Visal So , Sebastian Paeckel , Guido Pagano , John Martin , Mattia Moroder , François Damanet
picks.why_zh: 局域独立库在结构浴与 Abelian 强对称下可把时间关联转成多体纠缠稳态，并工程化谱以制备 GHZ-like 态——开放系统 × 多体纠缠制备。
picks.summary_zh: 作者展示如何用彼此独立的局域库，借助 Abelian 强对称与浴的时间关联，耗散制备真正多体纠缠稳态。在相互作用 Ising 链中，平坦浴对广泛的系统–环境耦合会指数抹去 Ising 轴关联；结构浴则把时间关联转为经典空间关联，强对称再将其提升到量子域以实现全局多体纠缠。弱耦合理论下，尽管生成元非二次，强对称仍把稳态构造化约为任意 Ising 耦合上的经典问题，并揭示经典可区分性与纠缠的精确联系；进一步工程化浴谱可增大关联长度并从可分初态制备 GHZ-like 态，且在精确 Markov 嵌入与张量网模拟中得到检验。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID。 未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: We present how to dissipatively prepare genuinely multipartite-entangled steady states with mutually independent local reservoirs by harnessing an Abelian strong symmetry and temporal bath correlations. In interacting Ising chains, we demonstrate that, for a broad class of system-environment couplings, flat baths exponentially erase Ising-axis correlations. Structured baths overcome this obstruction by converting temporal bath correlations into classical spatial correlations. Strong symmetry then promotes these correlations to the quantum domain, enabling global multipartite entanglement. Within weak-coupling theory, we obtain exact steady states despite the generator's nonquadratic nature: strong symmetry reduces their construction to a classical problem for arbitrary Ising couplings. This reduction reveals an exact connection between classical distinguishability and entanglement. We then show how to engineer the bath spectrum to increase the correlation length and enable the preparation of GHZ-like states from separable initial conditions. We test the mechanism beyond the analytical regime using exact Markovian embeddings and tensor-network simulations. Our approach is particularly suited to superconducting and trapped-ion platforms, and we propose a concrete implementation for the latter using sympathetically cooled motional modes.

picks.title: Gravitational anomaly spectroscopy of a Kitaev spin liquid
picks.subjects: Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)
picks.why_zh: 把手性中心荷 c 写成边缘光谱量：弱行波调制的吸收权重给出 C≡2D₂−4D₁=c，并可无标定提取 Ising anyon 共形自旋——Kitaev 自旋液 × 拓扑异常光谱。
picks.summary_zh: 手性中心荷 c 度量二维拓扑相的引力异常并固定边缘热流，既往多靠声子干扰的热输运或需纯基态的波函数探针。作者证明 c 是边缘的光谱量：沿边缘行进的弱耦合调制按 Virasoro 代数被吸收；相对同一耦合的静态响应归一化后，吸收权重满足 D_n=2n⟨L_0⟩+(c/12)(n³−n)，从而对理想边缘理论任意（含热）态有 C≡2D₂−4D₁=c。体中有/无 vison 的谱线权重比 Λ=4h_σ/c 无需标定即可固定非 Abel Ising anyon 的共形自旋。Kitaev 蜂窝自旋液在 7168 自旋上得 C≈0.49999、h_σ=0.06250；用谱线自身位移标定时约 96 自旋即可把 c 收到约 1%。

picks.abstract: The chiral central charge $c$ measures the gravitational anomaly of a two-dimensional topological phase. It fixes the heat current carried along the edge. So far, it has been accessed through thermal transport, where phonons complicate the signal, or through wave-function probes that need a pure ground state. Here we show that $c$ is a spectroscopic quantity of the edge. A weak modulation of the edge couplings that travel along the edge is absorbed according to the Virasoro algebra. Normalized by the response to a static change of the same couplings, the absorbed weights obey $D_n=2n\langle L_0\rangle+\frac{c}{12}(n^3-n)$, so that $\mathcal{C}\equiv2D_2-4D_1=c$ in any state of the ideal edge theory, thermal or not. The central charge thus appears in transition weights, although it cancels from excitation gaps. The ratio of line weights with and without a vison in the bulk, $\Lambda=4h_\sigma/c$, needs no calibration and fixes the conformal spin $h_\sigma$ of the non-Abelian Ising anyon. For the Kitaev honeycomb spin liquid we find $\mathcal{C}=0.49999$ and $h_\sigma=0.06250$ on 7168 spins. Calibrating with the shift of the measured line itself gives $c$ within about $1\%$ on 96 spins and within $1\%$ under $20\%$ random coupling errors. Interacting edge Majoranas in a fixed flux sector, treated with DMRG, keep $\mathcal{C}$ within $1.5\%$ while the edge velocity changes by $\pm13\%$. An exact simulation of a quantum-processor protocol, including the native Floquet circuit, returns $c$ within $3.5\%$ on 96 to 600 spins.
